About Us

Popcorn Manufacturer in Delhi —Making Every Moment More Delicious

Popcorn should feel like an experience, not just a snack — and that belief has driven TipTop Food Tech since 1991. As a popcorn manufacturer in Delhi, we have spent over 35+ years turning carefully selected corn into the kind of crunch people reach for during late-night cravings, family movie nights, and everything in between.

Today, that experience runs across 2 modern manufacturing units in Delhi, more than 25 popcorn varieties, and over 1 million happy customers. Our popcorn is air-popped, not fried, which keeps it light, naturally gluten-free, and just as satisfying without the extra oil.

How it's made

How We Manufacture — From Kernel to Pack

01

Sourcing

We hand-pick corn based on size, moisture, and popping expansion, since a bad kernel batch ruins the whole line.

02

Cleaning & Grading

Every batch is cleaned and graded before it enters production.

03

Air-Popping

We use air-popping technology instead of deep frying, which is what keeps our popcorn light, crispy, and lower in fat.

04

Flavouring

Butter, salt, cheese, caramel — each seasoning is applied fresh, in-house.

05

Hygienic Packing

Packed in moisture-proof, food-grade material to lock in crunch till it reaches the shelf.

06

Quality Checks

Every stage runs under FSSAI, ISO, and HACCP standards, not just the final product.
